newsitem.title: FRANCE: YACHTING-FRENCH CLAIM WORLD SAILING SPEED RECORD.
newsitem.headline: YACHTING-FRENCH CLAIM WORLD SAILING SPEED RECORD.

text.p: French naval designers said on Wednesday they had broken the world sailing speed record, reaching 41.6 knots (78 kph or 48 mph) over 500 metres (1,650 feet) aboard a catamaran off the Mediterranean port of Toulon.
They said the 10.5-metre (34.6-foot), 370-kilo (814-pound) catamaran, Techniques Avancees, was a hydrofoil using rigid sails.
